reason: No more guilty red wall sounds nice, and I'd probably start the no-card trial. But I've paid for Motion and Sunsama and dropped both within weeks, so I'm not paying for another one in month one before I see it survive a bad week.
objection: Something asking me 'done, push, shrink or drop?' every time a block ends sounds like nagging with nicer words. On a scattered day that's six little guilt pop-ups, and that's exactly when I close the app for good. Also it doesn't say whether my iCloud calendar shows up next to my work Google one.
would_change_my_mind: If I could turn the end-of-block check-in into one quiet end-of-day review, and both my Google and iCloud calendars showed up in one view, and I was still opening it on day 14 of the trial.
